title: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2, 11.11.x <= 11.11.1 fail to bound the work performed while…
description: Mattermost versions 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, 11.10.x up to 11.10.2, and 11.11.x up to 11.11.1 contain a vulnerability where the processing of EXIF orientation metadata is not properly bounded. This flaw allows an authenticated user to cause excessive server-side CPU consumption by uploading or linking a small image with specially crafted EXIF metadata. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity.
